# graphiant_playbook_module_slots (Data Source)

Module slots of an Automation Workflows catalog bundle: the module_key values a graphiant_playbook_config's files can fill, and which of them are required.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graphiant_playbook_module_slots" "system" {
  bundle_key = "system_bundle"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bundle_key` (String) Catalog bundle key, from graphiant_playbook_bundles.

### Read-Only

- `modules` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modules))

<a id="nestedatt--modules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modules`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `file_distinguisher` (String)
- `is_required` (Boolean)
- `module_key` (String)
- `name` (String)
